## Pursuing: 3

### BE in Computer Science & Engineering

A comprehensive program blending foundational computing principles, advanced technologies, and practical skills, preparing students for innovation, problem-solving, and impactful careers in software development, AI, and data engineering.

### BE in Computer Science & Engineering (AI & ML)

A specialized program focusing on Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning, equipping students with advanced skills to design intelligent systems, analyze data, and drive innovation in emerging technologies.

### BE in Mechanical Engineering

A dynamic program emphasizing core mechanical principles, advanced technologies, and hands-on skills, preparing students for innovative careers in design, manufacturing, automation, and sustainable engineering solutions.

### BE in Electronics & Communication Engineering

A versatile program integrating electronics, communication systems, and cutting-edge technologies, empowering students to innovate and excel in fields like IoT, robotics, signal processing, and telecommunications.

### BE in Electrical & Electronics Engineering

A comprehensive program blending electrical systems, electronics, and emerging technologies, preparing students to innovate and excel in power systems, automation, renewable energy, and electronic design.

### BE in Civil Engineering

A foundational program in planning, designing, and constructing infrastructure, equipping students with technical expertise and sustainable practices to shape resilient structures and transformative urban landscapes.

### Masters of Business Administration

A transformative program blending management theory, leadership skills, and real-world applications, preparing professionals to excel in strategic decision-making, entrepreneurship, and dynamic global business environments.

### M.Tech in Computer Science & Engineering

An advanced program in Computer Science, fostering expertise in cutting-edge technologies, research, and innovation to solve complex problems and drive advancements in computing and software development.

### M.Tech in Mechanical Engineering

An interdisciplinary program combining robotics, automation, and intelligent systems, equipping students with advanced skills to design, innovate, and lead in emerging technologies and industrial applications.

### M.Tech in Electronics & Communication Engineering(VLSI Design)

A specialized postgraduate program designed for fresh graduates aiming to excel in the field of Very-Large-Scale Integration (VLSI). This program offers advanced knowledge in semiconductor technology, digital and analog circuit design, and system-level integration. With a curriculum aligned to current industry needs, students gain hands-on experience and practical skills essential for careers in VLSI design, hardware innovation, and emerging chip technologies

### M.Tech in Civil Engineering

This forward-looking program bridges the gap between traditional civil engineering andmodern digital technologies. Designed for future-ready engineers, it equips you to leadadvancements in infrastructure planning, design, analysis, and intelligentmanagement—empowering you to drive innovation and sustainability in the builtenvironment. If you're ready to push boundaries and become a leader in the future of smartinfrastructure, this M.Tech program offers you the perfect platform. Today itself, empoweryour engineering journey with the tools of tomorrow.

### Masters in Computer Applications

A specialized program focusing on advanced computer science, software development, and IT management, preparing students for impactful careers in application development, system analysis, and technology innovation.

## About Vidyavardhaka College of Engineering

## VVCE – A Leading Institution in Engineering and Management Education

.Vidyavardhaka Sangha (VVS) stands as a synonym for quality education in the heritage city of Mysuru. VVS was established in 1949 by great visionaries namely Late Sahukar Channaiah and Late. K. Puttaswamy (Former Minister of Karnataka) to impart quality education to all sections of the society. There are ten educational institutions starting from nursery to engineering college under the aegis of VVS. At present, VVS is under the able guidance and leadership of Sri Gundappa Gowda, President, Sri Shivalingappa B, Vice President, Sri P. Vishwanath, Secretary and Sri. Shrishaila Ramannavar, Treasurer.

Vidyavardhaka College of Engineering is one of the prestigious engineering colleges in Karnataka. Established in 1997, VVCE has grown in leaps and bounds since inception. VVCE is an autonomous institute affiliated to Visvesvaraya Technological University (VTU), Belagavi, approved by AICTE & UGC, New Delhi and recognized by Govt. of Karnataka. Six UG programs are accredited by National Board of Accreditation, New Delhi. VVCE is also accredited by NAAC with “A” grade. VVCE offers six UG programs, six PG programs and nine Research Centres for pursuing PhD programs, with a total student population of over 5000+. The college has excellent infrastructure coupled with qualified and passionate faculty team to provide a perfect learning ambience. The college is under the able leadership of Dr. B. Sadashive Gowda, PhD (IISc) as Principal, who has rich experience in industry and education fields both in India and abroad.

The college has taken stringent measures as per AICTE/UGC norms to prevent any incidents of ragging.

## Vision & Mission

#### Vision

To be a globally renowned university imparting value-based education and promoting research to nurture responsible professionals for sustainable society.

#### Mission

- To provide innovative teaching-learning through state-of-the-art infrastructure and competent staff.

To provide innovative teaching-learning through state-of-the-art infrastructure and competent staff.

- To promote research and innovation in collaboration with industry and global institutions.

To promote research and innovation in collaboration with industry and global institutions.

- To inculcate professional ethics, leadership qualities, communication, and entrepreneurial skills for holistic development.

To inculcate professional ethics, leadership qualities, communication, and entrepreneurial skills for holistic development.

## Vidyavardhaka Sangha (VVS)

Vidyavardhaka Sangha (VVS) was established in 1949 by freedom fighters, philanthropists and visionary leaders namely Late Sahukar Channaiah and Late. K. Puttaswamy (Former Minister of Karnataka). VVS is a reputed and well established organization in Mysuru. VVS is managed by a managing committee consisting of 21 Members who work on honorary basis. VVS runs 10 educational institutions including Vidyavardhaka College of Engineering (VVCE). At present, VVS is under the able guidance and leadership of Sri Gundappa Gowda, President, Sri Shivalingappa B, Vice President, Sri P. Vishwanath, Secretary and Sri. Shrishaila Ramannavar, Treasurer.

Candidates should have a qualifying rank in either CET or COMED-K or JEE entrance tests.

## Admission Process for PG Programs (M.Tech, MBA & MCA)

Admissions to PG Programs are made as per KEA & VTU norms.

- Computer Science & Engineering

- Electronics & Communication Engineering(VLSI Design)

- Civil Engineering

For admissions to M.Tech Programs, the minimum aggregate percentage in the eligibility examination of Bachelor’s degree in BE/B.Tech is 50% for General Merit (GM) candidates and 45% for SC, ST, Cat-1, 2A, 2B, 3A and 3B category candidates. In addition, a qualifying rank in either PGCET/GATE is a must.

Out of the total seats, 80% is filled through KEA and 20% through Management quota.

For admissions to the MBA Program, the minimum percentage in eligibility examination of Bachelor’s degree in BBM/B.Com/B.Sc/BA/BE is 50% for General Merit (GM) candidates and 45% for SC, ST, Cat-1, 2A, 2B, 3A and 3B category candidates. In addition, a qualifying rank in either PGCET/KMAT/CMAT is a must.

Out of the total seats, 50% is filled through PGCET by KEA and 50% through Management.

For admission to MCA Programs, the candidates should have passed BCA / Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science & Engineering or equivalent Degree or passed in B.Sc., B.Com.. / B.A with Mathematics at 10+2 level or at Graduation level.Obtained at least of 50% marks in the qualifying examination, 45% SC/ST and Category-I of Karnataka Candidates. In addition, a qualifying rank in PGCET/KMAT is a must.

Out of the total seats, 50% is filled through PGCET by KEA and 50% through Management.

Invitation of applications for filling Management seats in MBA/M.Tech/MCA will be done sometime during July/August.

## Department of Mechanical Engineering

## Course Intake

## 120

## 4

## Students Placed (AY 2024-25)

## Introduction

Discover the core principles of Mechanical Engineering, where you will learn to design, analyze, and manufacture cutting-edge mechanical systems that shape the modern world. This program equips students with hands-on skills in Mechanical Design, Thermodynamics, Fluid mechanics, Robotics, Materials science and many more, preparing them for dynamic, high-impact careers in automotive, aerospace, renewable energy, and advanced manufacturing industries.

## Career Path Possibilities

## Courses Offered

The department offers one undergraduate courses and also a post graduate course.

## Undergraduate Courses

### BE in Mechanical Engineering

A dynamic program emphasizing core mechanical principles, advanced technologies, and hands-on skills, preparing students for innovative careers in design, manufacturing, automation, and sustainable engineering solutions.

## Postgraduate Courses

### M.Tech in Mechanical Engineering

An advanced program focused on mechanical system design, analysis, manufacturing, andemerging engineering technologies, equipping students with strong technical expertise,research aptitude, and problem-solving skills to innovate and lead in core industries,advanced manufacturing, and interdisciplinary engineering through a robust curriculum,hands-on experimentation, and industry-oriented learning.

## Student Milestones

### Year 1: Building the Foundation

- Develop a strong understanding of basic sciences (Physics, Chemistry, andMathematics) and core engineering concepts.

- Introduction to engineering drawing and computer programming.

- Familiarization with fundamental mechanical engineering principles.

- Participation in introductory projects to foster teamwork and problem-solving skills.

### Year 2: Strengthening Core Concepts

- In-depth study of core mechanical engineering subjects such as Material science,Strength of Materials, Thermodynamics, Fluid Mechanics, and ManufacturingProcesses.

- Hands-on experience through technical proficiency enhancement courses, lab workand mini-projects related to mechanical systems.

- Exposure to computational tools like CAD (Computer-Aided Design) and simulationsoftware.

- Engagement in technical seminars and industrial visits for practical insights.

### Year 3: Advanced Knowledge & Specialization

- Advanced coursework in Mechanical Engineering Design, Heat Transfer, EngineeringEconomics, and Computer Integrated Manufacturing.

- Exploration of emerging areas like Robotics, Mechatronics, and Renewable EnergySystems.

- Execution of an industry-oriented mini-project for real-world problem-solving.

- Internship opportunities to gain practical exposure in manufacturing, design, orresearch.

### Year 4: Innovation and Career Readiness

- Completion of core and elective courses in specialized areas such as robotics andautomation, Operations research, Product life cycle management or nanotechnology.

- Design and execution of a capstone project addressing industry or societal challenges.

- Participation in skill development programs, MOOCS, mock interviews, andplacement activities.

- Final-year internship to bridge the gap between academics and industry.

- Presentation of research papers or project findings in technical conferences orjournals.

### 2021

### Curriculum - M.Tech

## Department of Mechanical Engineering

Is for students…

who are innovative thinkers who want to master the world of machines. Students should have strong mathematical and analytical skills to understand how machines can be used as drivers of innovation. This course is for those who are looking for a cutting-edge exploration of physics, mathematics, and thermodynamics to create machines and technologies that drive innovation across borders and sectors.

Career Opportunities

- an aerospace engineer

- an automotive engineer

- a control & instrumentation engineer

- a maintenance engineer

- an analytical engineer

- a design engineer

- a test engineer

- a manufacturing engineer

- a development engineer

- a research engineer

- a sales engineer

- an engineering manager

- a consulting manager

The Department of Mechanical Engineering was established in 1997 with an annual intake of 60 students in the undergraduate programme and has grown by leaps and bounds since its inception, with the current undergraduate intake at 120. The department is housed in a well-equipped three-floor building with excellent infrastructure. It features state-of-the-art laboratories including CAD, Metallography and Materials Testing, Metrology, Foundry and Forging, Machine Shop, Fluid Mechanics, Heat Transfer, Energy Engineering, and Design labs. Advanced computing facilities and industry-standard software enhance student learning.

The department is led by Dr. Vinay K B, Head of the Department, and guided by experienced faculty specializing in Thermal, Design, Production, and Engineering Management with 26 PhD holders and 12 faculty pursuing doctoral studies, ensuring strong teaching and research excellence.

The department provides excellent placement opportunities through strong industry interaction, training, and career support. It regularly organizes expert talks and industrial visits to enhance students' theoretical knowledge and practical exposure. Conferences and workshops are conducted to strengthen technical expertise. Students are also encouraged to showcase their organizing and presentation skills through national-level conferences, competitions, and cultural activities.

Active student clubs such as ISHRAE, SAE BAJA, Vymanika, and the Rocketry Club promote hands-on learning and innovation. The department also houses the AICTE IDEA lab, ME Skill Development Center, EV Lab and the Dr. Babasaheb Neelkanth Kalyani Skill Development Centre for material research, sample preparation, and analysis, supporting advanced research and skill enhancement. The Department is extremely proud to have a Research Center recognised by Visvesvaraya Technological University (VTU), Belagavi.

ACTIVITIES FOR HOLISTIC DEVELOPMENT

## Vision

## Mission

- To provide students with a foundation in mechanical engineering principles through innovative teaching methods and hands-on learning experiences.

- To promote research and development in emerging areas through collaborations with industries and global institutions.

- To foster students’ leadership, communication, and entrepreneurial skills, preparing them for lifelong learning and global challenges.

## Program Educational Objective (PEOs)

Within a few years of graduation, a majority of our graduates will secure a suitable profession that involves Mechanical Engineering knowledge and skills, pursue higher studies which lead to useful research, become successful entrepreneurs and administrators to help the society in general. For these roles Department of Mechanical Engineering will prepare the students to:

PEO1:Apply the necessary mathematical and scientific knowledge as well as managerial and Mechanical Engineering procedures to analyze and solve real world problems within their work domain.

PEO2:Innovate, adopt and contribute to technologies and systems in the key domains of Mechanical Engineering.

PEO3:Communicate effectively as members and leaders of multicultural and multidisciplinary teams.

PEO4:Be sensitive to professional and societal contexts and committed to ethical action.

## PROGRAM SPECIFIC OUTCOMES (PSOs)

Students graduating in Mechanical Engineering will also be able to:

- Apply principles of basic sciences, mathematics, machine design, manufacturing, thermal engineering and management to solve real life mechanical engineering.

- Use professional engineering practices and strategies for the development, operation and maintenance of mechanical systems/processes

## PROGRAM OUTCOMES (POs)

PO1: Engineering Knowledge:Apply knowledge of mathematics, natural science, computing, engineering fundamentals, and an engineering specialization to the solution of complex engineering problems.

PO2: Problem Analysis:Identify, formulate, review research literature and analyze complex engineering problems reaching substantiated conclusions with consideration for sustainable development.

PO3: Design/Development of Solutions:Design creative solutions for complex engineering problems and design/develop systems/components/processes to meet identified needs with consideration for the public health and safety, whole-life cost, net zero carbon, culture, society and environment as required.

PO4: Conduct Investigations of Complex Problems:Conduct investigations of complex engineering problems using research-based knowledge including design of experiments, modelling, analysis & interpretation of data to provide valid conclusions.

PO5: Engineering Tool Usage:Create, select and apply appropriate techniques, resources and modern engineering & IT tools, including prediction and modelling recognizing their limitations to solve complex engineering problems.

PO6: The Engineer and The World:Analyze and evaluate societal and environmental aspects while solving complex engineering problems for its impact on sustainability with reference to economy, health, safety, legal framework, culture and environment.

PO7: Ethics:Apply ethical principles and commit to professional ethics, human values, diversity and inclusion; adhere to national & international laws.

PO8: Individual and Collaborative Team work:Function effectively as an individual, and as a member or leader in diverse/multi-disciplinary teams.

PO9: Communication:Communicate effectively and inclusively within the engineering community and society at large, such as being able to comprehend and write effective reports and design documentation, make effective presentations considering cultural, language, and learning differences

PO10: Project Management and Finance:Apply knowledge and understanding of engineering management principles and economic decision-making and apply these to one’s own work, as a member and leader in a team, and to manage projects and in multidisciplinary environments.

PO11: Life-Long Learning:Recognize the need for,  and have the preparation and ability for i) independent and life-long learning ii) adaptability to new and emerging technologies and iii) critical thinking in the broadest context of technological change.

## Mapping of Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) to Mechanical Engineering Domain

SDG | Relevance to Mechanical Engineering
 | Mechanical engineers play a key role in designing and optimizing renewable energy systems (solar, wind, hydro), improving energy efficiency, and developing sustainable power generation technologies.
 | Mechanical engineering contributes to the development of advanced manufacturing, automation, smart materials, and sustainable infrastructure, ensuring innovation in industrial processes.
 | Mechanical engineers work on waste reduction, sustainable product design, energy-efficient manufacturing, and circular economy solutions, minimizing environmental impact.

Mechanical engineers play a key role in designing and optimizing renewable energy systems (solar, wind, hydro), improving energy efficiency, and developing sustainable power generation technologies.

Mechanical engineering contributes to the development of advanced manufacturing, automation, smart materials, and sustainable infrastructure, ensuring innovation in industrial processes.

Mechanical engineers work on waste reduction, sustainable product design, energy-efficient manufacturing, and circular economy solutions, minimizing environmental impact.

## Introduction

The Department of Business Administration at Vidyavardhaka College of Engineering offers a comprehensive Master of Business Administration (MBA) program designed to cultivate leadership, strategic thinking, financial acumen, and managerial expertise. Since its inception in 2008, the department has empowered over 1,500 graduates to excel in diverse careers including business consulting, entrepreneurship, marketing, finance, and operations management. Our alumni are driving innovation and contributing to the success of organizations in dynamic and competitive global business environments. The program blends academic rigor with practical relevance, preparing students to become future-ready leaders equipped to navigate complex business challenges.

## Career Path Possibilities

## Specialisation Offered

FinanceA comprehensive program blending financial principles, analytical tools, and strategic insight to prepare professionals for leadership roles in investment, corporate finance, and financial decision-making.

MarketingA creative and strategic program combining branding, consumer psychology, and market analytics to shape professionals who drive growth and innovation in competitive business environments.

Human Resource ManagementA transformative program integrating leadership, organizational behaviour, and talent strategy to prepare professionals to lead workforce development and enhance employee experience.

Business AnalyticsAn insights-driven program merging data analytics, technology, and strategic thinking to equip professionals with the ability to solve business problems and support informed decisions.

Logistics & Supply Chain Management

A dynamic program integrating logistics, operations, and global trade practices to equip professionals with the skills to optimize value chains, manage risks, and drive efficiency in evolving business ecosystems.

Digital Marketing

An innovative program blending digital strategy, social media, SEO, and analytics to prepare professionals who can lead brand growth and customer engagement in the digital-first marketplace.

## Postgraduate Courses

### Masters in Business Administration

A transformative program blending management theory, leadership skills, and real-world applications, preparing professionals to excel in strategic decision-making, entrepreneurship, and dynamic global business environments.

## Student Milestones

### Year 1: Foundation Building

- Core Knowledge: Introduction to essential management subjects including Marketing, Finance, HR, Operations, and Economics.

- Skill Development: Focus on leadership, communication, teamwork, and analytical thinking.

- Industry Exposure: Guest lectures, industrial visits, and interactions with practitioners.

- Experiential Learning: Case studies, simulations, presentations, and management fests.

### Year 2: Specialization & Career Focus

- Domain Expertise: In-depth learning in chosen specialization – Finance, Marketing, HR, Project Management, Business Analytics, or Banking & Insurance.

- Real-World Projects: Industry internships, live projects, and applied learning opportunities.

- Professional Readiness: Resume building, mock interviews, and placement training.

- Advanced Engagement: Seminars, workshops, certifications, and research presentations.

## Department of Business Administration

TheDepartment of Business Administrationat VVCE is designed for aspiring leaders, strategic thinkers, and professionals passionate about making an impact in the business world. The department offers a transformative learning environment where students can hone their management skills, develop strong leadership capabilities, and apply theoretical knowledge to real-world business challenges.

Who is the department for?

Our programs cater to a diverse range of individuals—whether you’re aiming to advance in corporate management, start your own entrepreneurial venture, or specialize in fields such as marketing, finance, human resources, project management, business analytics, or banking & insurance. The department is for those who seek to thrive in a fast-paced, globally interconnected business environment. Whether you’re a recent graduate looking to enhance your career prospects or a working professional aiming to upskill and climb the corporate ladder, our MBA program equips you with the tools to succeed.

## Vision

To be a center of excellence in management education and research, nurturing ethical and innovative leaders to drive sustainable development in a dynamic global environment.

## Mission

- To deliver industry-relevant, technology-integrated management education through innovative pedagogy and experiential learning.

- To foster cutting-edge research, consultancy, and knowledge exchange in collaboration with industry and academic institutions globally.

- To develop responsible leaders with strong ethics, communication, leadership, and entrepreneurial skills for inclusive and sustainable growth.

## PROGRAM EDUCATIONAL OBJECTIVES (PEO)

PEO1:Apply problem-solving skills for ethical management practices in public and private sectors to meet the growing expectations of stakeholders.

PEO2:Exhibit the ability to take part in team-oriented tasks, discussions, and activities that prepare individuals to work as a team member as well as a leader with cross-functional teams.

PEO3:Demonstrate global perspectives to recognize and effectively turn international business dimensions into innovative business projects either as intrapreneur or entrepreneur.

## PROGRAM OUTCOME (PO)

PO1: Apply management knowledge and tools to solve real-world business problems ethically and efficiently.

PO2: Develop entrepreneurial abilities, manage innovation and drive sustainable growth.

PO3: Demonstrate data-driven decision-making, critical thinking, and analytical reasoning to enhance organizational performance

PO4: Communicate effectively and lead diverse teams to achieve organizational objectives in a global environment.

PO5: Pursue lifelong learning, conduct research, and respond to emerging business and societal challenges.
